patch_description: Instead of returning random points (which gives near-zero min triangle area), this approach deterministically optimizes a structured 13-point configuration inside a unit-area equilateral triangle using gradient ascent on a smooth soft-min approximation of the 286 triangle areas (LogSumExp over negative areas). The analytic gradient of the soft-min objective pushes all points away from near-collinear triplets simultaneously, while a projection step keeps every point inside the triangle. Since the hull of the optimized configuration equals the unit-area triangle, min_area_normalized is just the smallest triangle area. Multi-scale initialization (boundary ring + interior lattice + perturbations, fixed seed) followed by hundreds of fast vectorized iterations reliably converges to a locally optimal configuration with balanced Voronoi-like spacing, dramatically improving the minimum triangle area over the random baseline at negligible runtime cost.
